title: Systems Builder & Engineer
tagline: I solve problems by building the system that fixes them — software, AI agents and the operations around them — in whatever stack the problem needs.
summary: I build the systems that solve a problem, in whatever stack the problem needs. Mostly that is software: web and mobile products, APIs and data models, payments, back-office consoles, and AI agents that do real work behind safety gates written in code. Around it sits the operation: search and AI visibility, store and CMS work, monitoring and process. I run an independent studio for clients in Nigeria and the Netherlands; in 2026 that meant a 733-product retail storefront, a ticketed webinar platform and Dutch site and search work, alongside a live savings-circle product. I also co-founded a healthcare-marketplace startup as its CTO. In tech since 2010.
available: Taking on studio projects; open to senior and leadership roles in engineering, architecture, platform, data and AI, security and product, in any stack, and to operations, strategy, transformation and delivery work wherever a system can solve the problem. Based in Lagos: on-site or remote, worldwide.

studio.headline: I build and ship your product — fast, and built to last.
studio.pitch: Independent product studio — senior engineering, end to end. I take ideas to production-grade apps in weeks, not months — with what most freelancers skip: real test coverage, monitoring, and security built in from day one. No agency overhead.
